proposal.summary: Server-side request forgery in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) < 3.5.3 allows an administrative user to bypass database restrictions on the query setting page and connect to an unintended database.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: Server-side request forgery vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

PR.quote: A user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege may bypass the database restriction

C.quote: connect to a user unintended database

I.quote: connect to a user unintended database

A.quote: bypass the database restriction set on the query setting page

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request a full technical report or PoC and logs showing how the SSRF is exploited, including which requests are made and what data can be accessed; confirm affected configurations and whether non-admin users can trigger the issue.

evidence_quotes.claim: Type of vulnerability and affected product
